name: Shiki
source: Protagonist. Easygoing, gentlemanly, dependable, a bit of a daydreamer, smooth, honest to a fault, straightforward, more idealistic than realistic but not on either extreme. On rare occasions, distrustful because of his past, but this side of him surfaces and goes away quickly, a bit dense.
translation: Protagonist. Easygoing, gentlemanly, dependable, a bit of a daydreamer, smooth, honest to a fault, straightforward, more idealistic than realistic but not on either extreme. On rare occasions, distrustful because of his past, but this side of him surfaces and goes away quickly, a bit dense.
